title: mentha suaveolens var. lepteilema
intro: Mentha suaveolens var. lepteilema, commonly known as Peppermint, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, characterized by its distinctive minty aroma and flavor. The plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to alleviate nausea, digestive issues, and headaches, as well as its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha suaveolens var. lepteilema include its use as a carminative, expectorant, and antispasmodic, helping to relieve symptoms such as bloating, congestion, and muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of the plant include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and distinct fragrance.
